rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something conspicuous or visually noticeable, including a prominent position.

example.english: That sign is so big that it is prominent.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 ziu1 paai4 gam3 daai6 hou2 hin2 ngaan5

rows.note: Use this when “prominent” means important or having a significant role rather than merely being famous.

example.english: They play a prominent role in this project.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺呢個計劃入面擔當重要角色。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jap6 min6 daam1 dong1 zung6 jiu3 gok3 sik1

rows.note: Use this for the well-known or widely recognized side of “prominent,” especially for people.

example.english: This chef is very prominent locally.
example.traditional: 呢位廚師喺本地好出名。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 cyu4 si1 hai2 bun2 dei6 hou2 ceot1 meng2

rows.note: Use this when the person is socially prominent, respectable, or influential, not simply well-known.

example.english: He is a prominent figure in the district.
example.traditional: 佢喺區內係個有頭有面嘅人物。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 keoi1 noi6 hai6 go3 jau5 tau4 jau5 min6 ge3 jan4 mat6
